name: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment in China. The company provides slag energy saving and environmental protection treatment systems, such as dry slag and wet slag, and CFB boiler slag treatment systems; flue gas energy saving and environmental protection treatment systems; clean energy consumption systems; and desulfurization wastewater environmental protection treatment systems. It also offers energy-saving and environmentally protection treatment system for the metallurgical industry; and high thermal conductivity modified PPS pipes. The company serves customers in the fields of electricity, heat, chemical industry, metallurgy, waste disposal, new energy, etc. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Qingdao, China.
